items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: We made up a little band... I was playing the cornet and we had a fella named Lawrence Boynes who was playing clarinet... Lil' Well, he was playing drum.

ctx.x: Was that one of those straight flutes?

The straight ten flutes, yeah, the six hole. And a white fella by the name of Prechter, he happened to find an old cornet laying around his house. After he used to hear me playing that flute all the time, he gave me the cornet. I fooled around with that and played on it and tried to learn a couple of pieces, but I never would call myself a cornet player, you know? I was a little girl.
